prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: Havenline World1 appearance-upgrade proposal sheet. Produce a polished chunky rounded stylized3D reference sheet on a clean navy studio background. Warm timber, rounded blue steel, restrained orange mechanisms, soft sculpted snow on cold surfaces; no photoreal grit, primitive placeholders or sci-fi redesign. EXACTLY TWO new named appearance stages, arranged in TWO rows and THREE columns. Each row depicts the same coherent stage in FRONT THREE-QUARTER, REAR THREE-QUARTER, and FUNCTIONAL SIDE/DETAIL views. All six panels remain readable and uncropped. Keep camera elevation, object scale, floor footprint and lighting comparable; only camera changes within a stage. Never mirror ports or flip mechanisms between panels. No people, crew, pets, scenery, UI, level numbers, stat values, prices, capacities, watermarks or new resource names. The original base remains unchanged and is NOT a third row. These are authored visual proposals, not approved numerical upgrades, unlock levels, runtime animation or balance. Numeric equipment/world-level binding remains pending. Preserve the existing belt and resource scale; no new conveyor appearance or enlarged cargo. Show only a few representative existing inputs/outputs where needed for functional clarity, not full industrial scenes.

Primary subject: Quarry drill station.
Input image roles:
1. Existing selected baseline design: preserve recognizable silhouette, material family, footprint and the physical side/height/order of all inputs, outputs, controls and service positions. This request adds authored appearance concepts; it does not replace the retained base.
2. Owner-selected ordinary resource/cash size and unchanged character scale. Scale reference only; do not add a person or resize resources in output.
3. Owner-selected low orange/yellow conveyor, black rollers and transfer plate. Preserve belt width/height and machine handoff relationships; no new belt appearance proposals.

TOP ROW — Reinforced Quarry Station: Add stout blue frame braces and protected orange control linkage around the original drill/processing form.
BOTTOM ROW — Braced Quarry Station: Add reinforced base corners, a coherent guard around the working mechanism and improved existing output handling without enlarging the footprint.

Asset-specific invariants: Preserve the baseline tool/shaft, feed/work face, output collection location and service access. Current authored producer maps stone to blocks; the historical extraction-looking reference alone does not prove that process. Show no new ore-to-metal conversion, unknown stock or numerical yield.

Text: use only the asset name, the two exact stage names above, and short view captions FRONT / REAR / DETAIL. No level numbers, prices, quantities or stats.
Mandatory camera audit: column1 FRONT shows the actual front. Column2 REAR must show the opposite back of the SAME object, so physically left/right attachments reverse screen sides; do not merely rotate the front slightly and label it REAR. Column3 DETAIL must reveal functional contact/clearance. Keep all corresponding parts attached to the same physical sides. Preserve each stage across its three views. The selected quarry reference has a tall wooden drill derrick, blue/orange tracked rig, cab, rear engine and winch cable. Preserve this exact recognizable layout and two tracks. Reinforce the timber derrick with metal corners and the rig's same existing panels; do not replace it with a generic stone factory or add outputs not shown.
